reason: A DSH web UI theme plugin that changes interface, conversation, and code font families using CSS variable overrides and documented fallback stacks.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面、模型对话和代码区域应用 Anthropic 字体及中文回退字体。
summaries.en: Applies Anthropic fonts and Chinese fallback font stacks to the DeepSeek Harness web interface, conversations, and code areas.

capabilities: Injects client-side CSS to override interface, markdown, and code font-family variables
Applies font fallback stacks for Latin and Chinese text
